visualizations.title: 一个量子比特的线与面积 · 布洛赫球、旋子与双覆盖
visualizations.title_en: The line and the area of one qubit · Bloch sphere, rotors and the double cover
visualizations.summary: 在布洛赫球上拖动态矢量 B，对着量尺 A 看它的两个投影：共线的影子 A·B = cos θ 是“线”，决定探测器两种咔哒的比例；垂直撑开的面 |A∧B| = sin θ 是“面积”，决定干涉条纹的明暗对比；两者的平方和恒为 1。再给它加上量子门：每个门是一枚旋子，矢量转一圈回到原处时旋子差一个负号，转两圈才真正回来；H·Z·H 与 X 在球面上是同一个转动，旋子却是 −R_X。八张实验卡各讲其中一件事，可以在正文里单独引用。
visualizations.summary_en: Drag the state vector B on the Bloch sphere and read its two projections against the ruler A: the collinear shadow A·B = cos θ is the “line”, which sets the odds of the detector's two clicks; the perpendicular face |A∧B| = sin θ is the “area”, which sets the contrast of the interference fringes; their squares always sum to 1. Then add gates: each gate is a rotor, the rotor is off by a sign when the vector is back after one turn and returns only after two; H·Z·H and X are the same turn of the sphere, yet the rotor is −R_X. Each of the eight experiment cards makes one of these points and can be cited on its own from the text.

visualizations.title: 球外之球 · 有限的清单总留下一点在外面
visualizations.title_en: The sphere beyond the sphere · a finite list always leaves something outside
visualizations.summary: 四个场景画同一件事：有限步之后总有东西留在外面。对角线：逐行翻转对角元得到的串 d 与第 k 行在第 k 位不同，所以不在清单里；把 d 收编进去，新的对角线又翻出一个。割圆：内接正 n 边形（n = 6·2ᵏ，从刘徽的 6 边到祖冲之的 24576 边）与圆弧之间的缝 1 − cos(π/n) 永远大于零，放大镜一直把它放大到看得见。余弦：xₖ₊₁ = cos xₖ 的误差按等比缩小却不为零。素数：p₁⋯pₖ + 1 除以清单里每个素数都余 1，它的素因子都在清单之外。舞台下方的图画出“留在外面的量”随步数的变化。
visualizations.summary_en: Four scenes of one fact: after finitely many steps something is still outside. The diagonal: the string d obtained by flipping the diagonal bit of each row differs from row k in place k, so it is not on the list; absorb d and the new diagonal flips out another. The polygon: the gap 1 − cos(π/n) between the inscribed regular n-gon (n = 6·2ᵏ, from Liu Hui's 6 sides to Zu Chongzhi's 24576) and the arc is always positive, and a magnifier keeps it large enough to see. The cosine: the error of xₖ₊₁ = cos xₖ shrinks geometrically and is never zero. The primes: p₁⋯pₖ + 1 leaves remainder 1 on every listed prime, so its prime factors are off the list. The plots under the stage show what is left outside, step by step.

visualizations.title: ±1 接缝 · 佩尔的一格、线素数与面素数、模 p 数点
visualizations.title_en: The ±1 seam · Pell's one cell, line primes and plane primes, points mod p
visualizations.summary: 沿着 ±1 接缝走一遍的三个场景。佩尔接缝：√d（无平方因子 2 ≤ d ≤ 37）的渐近分数 m/n 在格点上沿直线越贴越近，|m/n − √d| 趋于零，m² − d·n² 却是非零整数；两条色带末端的放大镜显示它们永远差着整数格，差值的符号来回翻转，连分数周期为奇数时才取得到 −1（d = 5 时绿圈标出已由 Lean 验证的全部 ±4 解）。线素数与面素数：半径 √p 的圆上有格点当且仅当 p ≡ 1 (mod 4)，这时 a + bi 的平方给出整数直角三角形。模 p 数点：曲线 y² = x³ − x 在 𝔽ₚ 上的 aₚ 被哈塞界 ±2√p 关住，线素数恰在零上，面素数的余弦等于高斯三角形的余弦；换成 y² = x³ − x + 1，余弦的分布贴近半圆律。
visualizations.summary_en: Three scenes along the ±1 seam. The Pell seam: on the lattice the convergents m/n of √d (squarefree 2 ≤ d ≤ 37) hug the line ever more closely, |m/n − √d| goes to zero, yet m² − d·n² is a nonzero integer; a magnifier on the ends of two bands shows that they always differ by whole cells, the sign of the gap flips back and forth, and −1 is reached only when the period of the continued fraction is odd (for d = 5 the green rings mark all the ±4 solutions, as verified in Lean). Line primes and plane primes: the circle of radius √p passes through lattice points exactly when p ≡ 1 (mod 4), and then the square of a + bi gives an integer right triangle. Points mod p: for the curve y² = x³ − x over 𝔽ₚ, aₚ is held inside Hasse's bound ±2√p, line primes sit exactly at zero and the cosine of a plane prime equals the cosine of its Gaussian triangle; for y² = x³ − x + 1 the cosines follow the semicircle law.

visualizations.title: 没有时间的必然 · 格拉姆窗口、书页、场与线
visualizations.title_en: Necessity without time · the Gram window, a book of pages, a field and a thread
visualizations.summary: 同一颗球上的四个场景。窗口：B 立在北极，A 与它夹角 θ₁，C 只能绕它转，于是 A·C = cos θ₁ cos θ₂ + sin θ₁ sin θ₂ cos φ 只能落在 [cos(θ₁ + θ₂), cos(θ₁ − θ₂)] 里；det G 是三根向量撑开的体积的平方，贴上窗边时三者共面、体积为零，窗外 det G 为负，没有向量能实现。书页：有限时钟上所有页同时画在球上，整本书在“拨一格”之下不变，条件化才取出读头下的那一页。场：势能 V = 1 − cos α 的梯度流从任何地方都流向目标，降下的势能等于走过的耗散。线：在 N = 2ⁿ 个候选里找一个目标，振幅放大每步只转 2θ，约 (π/4)√N 步到达。把它们读作“选择”“书页”“场”与“线”是本书终章的诠释。
visualizations.summary_en: Four scenes on one sphere. The window: B stands at the north pole, A makes the angle θ₁ with it and C can only go around it, so A·C = cos θ₁ cos θ₂ + sin θ₁ sin θ₂ cos φ can only fall in [cos(θ₁ + θ₂), cos(θ₁ − θ₂)]; det G is the squared volume the three vectors span, zero at the edges of the window where they are coplanar and negative outside, where no vectors exist. The pages: on a finite clock all pages are drawn on the sphere at once, the whole book is unchanged by a tick, and conditioning picks the page under the reading head. The field: the gradient flow of V = 1 − cos α runs to the target from anywhere, and the potential it loses equals the dissipation it pays. The thread: to find one target among N = 2ⁿ candidates amplitude amplification turns only 2θ per step and arrives after about (π/4)√N steps. Reading these as “choice”, “pages”, “field” and “thread” is the interpretation of this book's coda.
tags_en: P is a field, NP is a line
